technomadcode-ai-product-development-too.description: Plan the MVP build from a PRD and an MVP scope, as a full development plan or an ultra-lean build spec, with the AI Product Development Toolkit's planning prompts.
Define the smallest first version worth building (the MVP scope) from a PRD through a guided interview, with the AI Product Development Toolkit's MVP scope prompt.
Set up the current empty folder with the AI App Starter, so the agent builds a Next.js, Supabase and Vercel app with the owner step by step, from idea to launch.
Interview the owner about a product idea, then draft a Product Requirements Document (PRD) with the AI Product Development Toolkit's PRD prompt.

Make a short video about a product or brand (promo, launch, explainer, demo or social clip) entirely in code with Remotion, from idea to a rendered MP4 with sound. The owner approves the idea and a storyboard before anything is built.
Draft a test plan outline (scope, test types, environments, and entry and exit criteria) through a guided interview, with the AI Product Development Toolkit's test plan prompt.
Plan a user research questionnaire, or turn collected responses into evidence-linked input for a PRD, with the AI Product Development Toolkit's research prompts.
Turn a PRD into UX specifications (screens, user flows and interaction patterns) through a guided interview, with the AI Product Development Toolkit's UX prompt.
